scope: synthetic XOR survival diagnostic only; no new main-model module, patient adapter or server operation
data: exact private_xor training/test data and noise schedules from the previous 48-run matrix; these are attribution controls, not independent confirmation
optimizer: Adam .003, batch32, no clipping, fixed last update
oracle_shared_input: true scalar shared factor in first G coordinate, no XOR/latent risk in G
oracle_private_code: each modality receives only its own planted bit, never XOR; clean controls are deterministic capacity checks with no finite KL claim; rate1 Gaussian code uses mu=sqrt(1-exp(-2))*bit and variance exp(-2) in active dimension, standard normal elsewhere
parameters: same initial phi, role constants and survival head as original model; after_phi trains head only, other oracle controls train full readout only; all encoders/posteriors frozen
noisy_code_qualification: single uses one active slot per modality, repeated duplicates the same bit in all four slots; repeated is denoising/redundancy control, not complementary-slot evidence
replay_acceptance: initial hash, all original cached shared/private/phi tensors and original test expected NLL must match before interpreting fixed-readout interventions
warmstart_refit: from exact replayed model, freeze encoders/shared/private posterior and prior; add 500 readout-only updates on original training rows; extra optimization, not a fair new-method comparison
bayes_controls: proper mixture of survival distributions using noisy-bit posterior, not mean hazards or sigmoid of mean risk; independent censoring convention matches source survival_nll
evaluation: five paired stochastic draws scored separately; average NLL, not averaged predictions; no validation checkpoint/hyperparameter selection
outputs: public aggregates/hashes only; synthetic arrays and replayed model/readout states remain ignored
limits: oracle role/bit/shared factors are privileged positive controls; null finite readout refits do not prove absent information; perturbations measure fixed-network sensitivity, not patient causality
